title: File the GST return
summary: Send the month's GST return to the tax office, once an account is connected.
text: Prepare the GST return for [month] from final invoices and bills only, show me every figure and where it came from, and wait for my yes. Only after I say yes, file it with the tax office through the connected account. If any figure is missing or does not add up, stop and tell me instead of filing.
